ideas.children_he: דִּינָה נִפְגְּעָה מִשְּׁכֶם. אָסוּר לְפְגֹעַ בְּגוּפוֹ וּבִכְבוֹדוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם.
ideas.children_en: Dina, Leah's daughter, went out to meet local girls. Shechem saw her, took her, and hurt her. Then he asked his father to give Dina to him as a wife.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים כָּעֲסוּ כְּשֶׁשָּׁמְעוּ עַל הַפְּגִיעָה בְּדִינָה.
ideas.children_en: Jacob heard about what happened to Dina and stayed quiet. His sons came back angry and sad because their family was insulted.

ideas.children_he: מַתָּנוֹת וְהַבְטָחוֹת אֵינָן מוֹחֲקוֹת פְּגִיעָה בְּאָדָם.
ideas.children_en: Hamor and Shechem offered to live closely and marry Dina. Shechem promised a big payment to get her.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים הִצִּיעוּ הֶסְכֵּם, אֲבָל לֹא גִּלּוּ אֶת כַּוָּנוֹתֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: Jacob’s sons said Shechem’s people must be circumcised to join with them. If not, they would take Dina and leave.

ideas.children_he: אַנְשֵׁי שְׁכֶם הֶאֱמִינוּ שֶׁהַהֶסְכֵּם יָבִיא שָׁלוֹם.
ideas.children_en: Shechem’s people agreed to circumcise themselves. They did it even though it hurt, to join with Jacob’s group.

ideas.children_he: שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי הִשְׁתַּמְּשׁוּ בְּאַלִּימוּת קָשָׁה כְּדֵי לִנְקֹם.
ideas.children_en: On the third day, while Shechem’s people were hurting, Simeon and Levi killed all the men. They took Dina and left.
Jacob’s other sons robbed the city. They took goods and returned their families, like in a war.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב חָשַׁשׁ שֶׁהָאַלִּימוּת תְּסַכֵּן אֶת כָּל הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה.
ideas.children_en: Jacob was upset at Simeon and Levi. Their actions hurt the family’s reputation and could bring danger from neighbors.

ideas.children_he: חָשׁוּב לְהָגֵן עַל מִי שֶׁנִּפְגַּע, אֲבָל נְקָמָה אֵינָהּ תָּמִיד צֶדֶק.
ideas.children_en: Simeon and Levi said Dina must be protected. They would not accept silence after what happened to her.
